title.en: Local government, shared jobs and First Nations
title.fr: Le gouvernement local, les responsabilités partagées et les Premières Nations

text.en: A municipal council is usually made up of a mayor (or reeve) and councillors or aldermen.
text.fr: Un conseil municipal se compose habituellement d'un maire (ou d'un préfet) et de conseillers ou d'échevins.

source.quote: The council usually includes a mayor (or a reeve) and councillors or aldermen.

text.en: Municipalities usually take care of city or regional planning, streets and roads, and sanitation, such as picking up garbage. They also handle snow removal, firefighting, ambulances and other emergency services, public transit, places for recreation, and some local health and social services.
text.fr: Les municipalités s'occupent habituellement de l'aménagement urbain ou régional, des rues et des routes, et de l'hygiène publique, comme la collecte des ordures. Elles s'occupent aussi du déneigement, des services d'incendie, des ambulances et des autres services d'urgence, du transport en commun, des installations de loisirs et de certains services locaux de santé et de services sociaux.

source.quote: Municipalities are normally responsible for urban or regional planning, streets and roads, sanitation (such as garbage removal), snow removal, firefighting, ambulance and other emergency services, recreation facilities, public transit and some local health and social services.

text.en: Most big cities have their own municipal police force.
text.fr: La plupart des grandes villes ont leur propre service de police municipal.

source.quote: Most major urban centres have municipal police forces.

text.en: Some responsibilities are shared by the federal government and the provinces and territories: immigration, agriculture and the environment.
text.fr: Certaines responsabilités sont partagées entre le gouvernement fédéral et les provinces et territoires : l'immigration, l'agriculture et l'environnement.

text.en: First Nations have band chiefs and councillors. They have major responsibilities on First Nations reserves, such as housing, schools and other services.
text.fr: Les Premières Nations ont des chefs de bande et des conseillers. Ceux-ci assument d'importantes responsabilités dans les réserves des Premières Nations, comme le logement, les écoles et d'autres services.

source.quote: The First Nations have band chiefs and councillors who have major responsibilities on First Nations reserves, including housing, schools and other services.

text.en: Many Aboriginal organizations, at the provincial, regional and national levels, speak for First Nations, Métis and Inuit people in their dealings with the federal, provincial and territorial governments.
text.fr: De nombreuses organisations autochtones, provinciales, régionales et nationales, font entendre la voix des Premières Nations, des Métis et des Inuits dans leurs relations avec les gouvernements fédéral, provinciaux et territoriaux.

source.quote: There are a number of provincial, regional and national Aboriginal organizations that are a voice for First Nations, Métis and Inuit people in their relationships with the federal, provincial and territorial governments.
